canonical_statement: For a nonempty linearly ordered typed direct system of nonempty structures in one first-order language, whose coherent transition maps are elementary embeddings, the canonical embedding of every stage into the direct limit is elementary.
domain_and_universes: L : Language.{uL,uS}; iota : Type v; G i : Type w; Prop in Lean universe 0
ordered_binders: f : forall i j, i <= j -> ElementaryEmbedding L (G i) (G j)
[DirectedSystem G (fun i j h => (f i j h).toEmbedding)]
hypotheses: the index type is a nonempty linear order
every carrier is nonempty and interprets the same language
the underlying embeddings satisfy identity and composition coherence
conclusion: For every i, there is an elementary embedding e from G i into the mathlib direct limit whose underlying embedding is exactly Language.DirectLimit.of at i.
encoding_decision: The typed direct-limit form is canonical. It does not add a common ambient carrier. Equality of the elementary embedding's underlying embedding with DirectLimit.of prevents an existentially unrelated map from satisfying the conclusion.

degenerate_cases: The empty index is excluded. Singleton chains and chains with a greatest element remain included. No countability, ordinal-index, finite-language, or shared-carrier restriction is imposed.
alternate_encodings: The common-ambient directed-supremum form remains an alternate presentation. Its equivalence to this typed target requires a later checked transport and receives no statement credit here.
